coverage.summary: Residential rental property statewide. Applies to owners of residential rental property (landlords) and their agents, with respect to applicants, including guarantors and cosigners.
coverage.other_conditions: Does not preempt provisions or regulations governing deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs.

evidence.quoted_span: “landlord” means an owner of residential rental property.

“applicant” means any entity or individual who makes a request to a landlord or their agent to rent a residential housing unit, or an entity or individual who agrees to act as a guarantor or cosignor on a rental agreement.
to preempt any provisions or regulations that govern the collection of deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs.

result.notes: I removed the Berkeley local disclosure duty (BMC 13.78.010) from other_conditions. No supplied document mentions it; D005 is not among the documents provided. I reworded the summary to describe owners and applicants rather than the conduct of charging fees. The statute sets no unit-count, construction-date or owner-type limits, so those fields stay null.
